title: Return integer CPU UIDs while preserving existing physical identities
limits: Keeps each UID span16bytes and appends a55-byte root helper. Valid APTC entries return existing physical IDs; FF entries receive unique disjoint32-bit sentinel IDs. Native producers, status, MAT and routing stay unchanged. Relative helper lookup is checked against50 factory namespaces. Whole OS/firmware/container integration remains untested.
